name: Design
blurb: The design committee surveys the site, runs the structural calculations, and produces the drawings that our partner engineers sign off on.

name: Fundraising
blurb: The fundraising committee writes grants, runs events, and talks to sponsors so that the bridge and the trip are paid for.

name: Outreach
blurb: The outreach committee runs our social media, recruits new members, and visits local schools to talk about engineering.

name: Logistics
blurb: The logistics committee plans the build trip, which covers travel, health and safety, the budget, and coordination with our partners abroad.
